title: Jam
summary: JAM, noun A conserve of fruits boiled with sugar and water. 1. A kind of frock for children. JAM, verb transitive 1. To press; to crowd; to wedge in. 2. In England, to tread hard or make firm by tread

inlines.v: JAM, noun A conserve of fruits boiled with sugar and water. 1. A kind of frock for children. JAM, verb transitive 1. To press; to crowd; to wedge in. 2. In England, to tread hard or make firm by treading, as land by cattle. JAM
